findings.excerpt: theorem heavyFlag_at (D : Data X N H) (n : Fin N) : D.heavyFlag n.val↔D.heavy n := by
findings.problem: This canonical restriction rule is not registered with simp. In heavy_mover, the condition `D.heavyFlag n.val` must explicitly be rewritten to the finite-index predicate `D.heavy n`. Consequently, ordinary simplification cannot normalize this boundary expression without naming the lemma or unfolding the existential encoding.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp]` to `heavyFlag_at`, retaining its current left-to-right orientation. This lets simp normalize `(if D.heavyFlag n.val then 0 else dist (D.center n) p)` to `(if D.heavy n then 0 else dist (D.center n) p)`.
findings.benefit: Makes finite-index flag conditions simplify automatically while preserving the schedule abstraction at arbitrary natural-number times. The rule removes the wrapper without expanding the schedule or introducing a reverse rewrite; when N = 0, there is no index to which it applies.
